title: Automated Industry
purpose: Replace repeated mining, transport, processing, and crafting labor with physical automation.
optimization_opportunities: Start the Quarry early, feed processing directly, parallelize bottleneck machines, and buffer outputs.
infrastructure_reuse: The Quarry, routes, processors, and autocrafter become the raw-material backbone of heavy industry.

milestones.title: Automated Ore Processing
final_validation: Route raw ore through processing into organized output without hand transfer.

milestones.title: Quarry Extraction
final_validation: Build and run a BuildCraft Quarry.

milestones.title: Physical Logistics Network
final_validation: Route Quarry output with BuildCraft pipes, ProjectRed tubes, Logistics Pipes, or rail.

milestones.title: Loaded Industrial Area
final_validation: Keep the automated industrial area loaded using an appropriate chunk-loading system.

milestones.title: Remote Factory Control
final_validation: Start or stop a production subsystem using wireless redstone.

milestones.title: Early Autocrafting
final_validation: Use a fixed-recipe automatic crafting table with physical ingredient routing for a repeated recipe.

milestones.title: Automation Throughput Demonstration
final_validation: Demonstrate sustained throughput above manual production.
